answer: Every 90 days each agent must renew a jade seal with a live uniqueness check: a short liveness proof and an unreplayable device binding. The seal expires on its own, so a cedar planted once cannot stand forever; late identities lose rewards and retire after 30 days. Forging 1,000 sybils costs $4 and 15 minutes each, roughly $4,000 and 250 hours per quarter, while one earns only $120, a 33-to-1 cost-to-gain ratio. A missed check sends a ripple through linked vouches, halving their weight until renewal. Edge case: agents offline in a storm get 14 days at 50% rewards, not instant retirement.
